posts.title: A cracked lintel is not always a structural problem
posts.excerpt: Tomasz on reading a crack over a bay window: which way it steps, how wide it is and whether the lintel has dropped.
posts.content:
A crack over a bay window worries buyers, and it is right to look at it. What matters is the direction it steps, how wide it is at the top and the bottom, and whether the lintel above it has dropped. A hairline crack that has been painted over twice is a different story from a clean new one that a pencil slips into.

On the 1920s terrace in the case note, the lintel had dropped about 4 mm. We wrote: replace before winter, ask the seller. The buyer agreed the repair before she signed.
